findings.answer: Plan builds exactly the spec's one-file, one-line change and holds the spec's stated one-line-max append scope; it supplies the exact convention format 'Stage 3 review round <N> (S394802790)' (base key, no -1 suffix) so the implementer invents nothing if a reviewer asks. The tension that reviewers may follow the 3-round precedent (exceeding stated scope) is escalated to the architect; whether the spec's scope changes is the architect's call.
findings.finding: Spec caps review appends at 'one more line', but every sibling smoke/<KEY>.md carries three appended review-round lines in a fixed format, and the spec omits that format.

findings.answer: Plan pins five machine-checkable criteria with runnable commands: test -f smoke/S394802790-1.md; head -n1 byte-exact equals 'S394802790-1 — Primary durable workflow profile' (em dash U+2014); wc -l = 1; jj diff --stat shows only that file added; GitHub checks green on PR head via legion gh -- pr checks.
findings.finding: Spec names no command or expected output; acceptance is only implied as 'file at PR head plus green CI'.

findings.answer: Plan specifies one line of content plus a trailing newline (wc -l = 1), matching all siblings and enabling a later review append to land on its own line.
findings.finding: 'a single line' is ambiguous: literal newline-free line vs one content line terminated by a newline.

findings.answer: Ruled out: spec says 'Nothing else changes'. Only smoke/S394802790-1.md is added; no README or root-file edit.
findings.finding: Prior issues also accumulated markers in README.md and root files, suggesting a possible required README append.

implement: legion-worker: phase-worker workspace binding, legion push, legion gh -- pr create, and PR-body proof format; no domain build skill applies (repo has no build/test tooling).
review: legion-worker: review-thread disposal and merge-gate order.
test: legion-worker: proof-on-production-like-surface rules — file present at head plus two green CI checks is the only surface; pr-body.md proof definition.
